generation.label: hook
generation.narration: AC blowing warm — can you just add refrigerant and call it fixed?
generation.prompt: Close-up on a car dashboard AC vent, louvers open, faint heat shimmer visibly rising from the vent instead of cold mist, warm interior backlight.
generation.negativePrompt: human face, person, hands, gloves, arms, talking head, low-res, blurry, extra fingers, plastic glow, oversaturated AI look, warped engine parts
generation.openingFrame: the heat shimmer clearly visible against the vent, strongest possible first frame, unbranded, wordless

generation.label: myth
generation.narration: Your car's AC is a sealed system. It doesn't burn through refrigerant like gas in a tank.
generation.prompt: Object-only shot under a car's open hood, a sealed AC compressor and refrigerant line assembly, engine bay ambient light, camera slowly pushes in on the closed fitting caps — no hands, nothing being touched, emphasizing a self-contained sealed loop.
generation.negativePrompt: human face, person, hands, gloves, arms, talking head, low-res, blurry, extra fingers, plastic glow, oversaturated AI look, warped engine parts
generation.openingFrame: continue directly from beat 1's dashboard into the engine bay, same vehicle

generation.label: explanation
generation.narration: If the level is low, refrigerant escaped somewhere. Adding more just masks a leak instead of finding it.
generation.prompt: Object-only technical cutaway diagram of a closed AC refrigerant loop — compressor, condenser, evaporator connected by lines — with a small highlighted fitting where a thin vapor wisp visibly escapes; clean diagrammatic lighting, slow camera push-in; no text or labels rendered in-scene.
generation.negativePrompt: human face, person, hands, gloves, arms, talking head, low-res, blurry, extra fingers, plastic glow, oversaturated AI look, warped engine parts, on-screen text, logos, watermarks
generation.openingFrame: establish the sealed loop clearly at a glance before the leak point is highlighted

generation.label: consequence
generation.narration: Topping off without fixing the leak can strain the compressor and lead to a bigger repair down the road.
generation.prompt: Close-up on an AC compressor clutch pulley engaging and disengaging erratically under strain, visible cycling/chatter of the clutch face, engine bay ambient, backlit to show the mechanical motion clearly.
generation.negativePrompt: human face, person, hands, gloves, arms, talking head, low-res, blurry, extra fingers, plastic glow, oversaturated AI look, warped engine parts

generation.label: safe_action
generation.narration: One clue is not a diagnosis — a proper recharge starts with a leak check, not a can from the parts store.
generation.prompt: A UV inspection light on a stand sweeps its beam across an engine bay AC line fitting, revealing a faint fluorescent dye glow at the leak point — no hands present, the light beam itself is the only motion besides a slow rack-focus.
generation.negativePrompt: human face, person, hands, gloves, arms, talking head, low-res, blurry, extra fingers, plastic glow, oversaturated AI look, warped engine parts
generation.openingFrame: fitting clearly readable, light beam entering frame
